'''Kitjitsu''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Tindercub]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Taiglow]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Following those who came before, Kitjitsu steadily hones those inner flames in meditation. It's time to grow up to protect everything held dear."

Kitjitsu is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Kitjitsu's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Taiglow]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Kitjitsu to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards) or Cozy Farm (use x4000 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Master's 2nd lesson: It's all about a paw-some focus. Kitjitsu's one-inch punch is un-fur-gettable!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "With age comes calm and reliability. Kitjitsu can now stay silent for an entire day and detect the faintest shifts in creatures faraway when meditating."

==Strategy==
[[File:Kitjitsu Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Kitjitsu's attack range]]
Best paired with Tatari that can inflict Burn, because Kitjitsu can recover HP when hitting Burning enemies.
